fine_lines.title: un- / in- / im- / dis-
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كل هذه البادئات تعني «غير / لا» وتعطي عكس الصفة. un هي الأكثر شيوعاً: untidy, uncomfortable, unbelievable. in: inexpensive. im قبل p و m غالباً: imperfect, impossible. dis: dishonest, disagree. يجب حفظ كل كلمة مع بادئتها.
fine_lines.explanation_en: All these prefixes mean "not" and make the opposite. un- is the most common: untidy, uncomfortable, unbelievable. in-: inexpensive. im- usually before p or m: imperfect, impossible. dis-: dishonest, disagree. Learn each word with its prefix.

examples.sentence: Nobody is perfect; we are all imperfect.

fine_lines.title: tired vs tired of
fine_lines.explanation_ar: tired وحدها = متعب (تحتاج للنوم أو الراحة). tired of + شيء = سئمت منه ولا أريده بعد الآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Tired" alone means you need rest. "Tired of" + something means you are bored or annoyed by it.

examples.sentence: I am tired. I want to sleep.
I am tired of this rainy weather.

fine_lines.title: unbelievable: good or bad?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: unbelievable تعني «لا يُصدّق» وقد تُقال عن شيء جيد جداً أو سيئ جداً حسب السياق. بيت قالها متفاجئاً من شعر آنا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Unbelievable" means very surprising. It can be very good or very bad, depending on the situation. Pete says it when he sees Anna's hair.

examples.sentence: The view from the mountain was unbelievable!

grammar.title: Negative prefixes: un-, in-, im-, dis-
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف بادئة قبل الصفة لنعطي معناها المعاكس، دون تغيير الكلمة الأصلية: tidy → untidy، comfortable → uncomfortable، believable → unbelievable، expensive → inexpensive، perfect → imperfect، honest → dishonest. وأحياناً على الأفعال: agree → disagree.
grammar.explanation_en: Add a prefix before an adjective to make the opposite meaning; the base word does not change: tidy → untidy, comfortable → uncomfortable, believable → unbelievable, expensive → inexpensive, perfect → imperfect, honest → dishonest. Also with some verbs: agree → disagree.
examples: I am tired of my untidy hair.
This is not perfect. This is imperfect!

grammar.title: Future with will: questions and plans
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن المستقبل بـ Will + الفاعل + الفعل: Will it be windy this weekend? ونستخدم I'll لقرار في اللحظة: I'll listen to the news. I'll pay with a credit card. وwill لتوقع مؤكد: My delivery will arrive in 2 days. Your hair will be okay.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask about the future with Will + subject + verb: Will it be windy this weekend? Use I'll for a decision made now: I'll listen to the news. Use will for a sure prediction: My delivery will arrive in 2 days.
examples: Will it be windy this weekend?
